image_description: A side-profile view of a small turtle, likely a mud or musk turtle, walking on a reddish-brown tiled floor. The turtle has a high-domed, olive-brown carapace with visible scute seams and some dark mottling. Its head is extended, showing a pointed snout and small eye. The limbs are short, stout, and webbed with visible claws. The plastron (underside) appears yellowish-orange where visible between the legs.
